original_ai_output.title_zh: 索马里海盗在救援前杀害油轮船员，官员向BBC透露
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据索马里邦特兰地区一名高级官员向BBC透露，一艘在索马里沿海被海盗劫持的油轮在地方安全部队夺回前，有5名船员被海盗杀害，另有4人受伤。该油轮载有约18500桶运往摩加迪沙的石油，于4月被6名武装人员劫持。16名疑似海盗已被逮捕，其余人员在逃并被追捕。该官员否认邦特兰部队协助部分海盗逃脱，当局尚未公布5名船员遇害及海盗控制船只的更多细节。

location.site: Xaafun与Bander Beyla之间的索马里沿海
location.raw_text: anchored near the Somali coast between the fishing towns of Xaafun and Bander Beyla

key_facts.fact: 一名地区高级官员向BBC表示，5名油轮船员在海盗劫持期间被杀害
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Five crew members of an oil tanker seized by pirates off the coast of Somalia were killed before local security forces retook the vessel, a senior regional official has told the BBC.

key_facts.fact: 遇难者包括三名巴基斯坦人、一名印度人和一名缅甸人，另有四人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He said the dead included three Pakistani nationals, one Indian and one national of Myanmar. Four other crew members were injured, including three Pakistanis and one Indian.

key_facts.fact: 该油轮载有约18500桶运往摩加迪沙的石油，于4月被6名武装人员劫持
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The tanker, which was carrying about 18,500 barrels of oil destined for the Somali capital, Mogadishu, was seized in April by six armed men while sailing off the coast of Somalia.

key_facts.fact: 16名疑似海盗已被逮捕，其余人员在逃并被追捕
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Sixteen suspected pirates have been arrested, while others escaped and were being pursued, officials said.

key_facts.fact: 邦特兰副信息部长否认当地部队协助部分海盗逃脱
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Qabowsade rejected suggestions that forces from Puntland, a semi-autonomous region of Somalia, had helped some of the pirates escape.

key_facts.fact: 被劫持油轮停泊在Xaafun与Bander Beyla两个渔镇之间的索马里沿海
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The hijacked tanker was anchored near the Somali coast between the fishing towns of Xaafun and Bander Beyla.

uncertainties: 船员遇害及海盗控制船只的具体经过尚未公布
邦特兰部队是否协助部分海盗逃脱的说法存在争议，官员予以否认
目前仅单一来源（BBC援引一名地区官员）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
